what: Inspector silently showed old routes and API reference after a failed development reload.
expected: Keep working routes visible and display a persistent reload error with its cause and recovery steps.
observed: The live routes page showed connected and one hello route despite many failed reloads; diagnostics returned no errors.
root_cause: apps/inspector/app/inspector-shell.tsx used only the active child graph connection for status. Failed reloads belong to the CLI supervisor; the active child diagnostics remain empty. No shell component consumed retained dev.generation.failed logs or startup failures.
fixed_by: Added a global failure banner backed by retained supervisor logs. It explains the previous version is serving, provides Docker-specific recovery, correlates startup errors to the failed build window, links filtered error logs, and clears on a later dev.generation.active record. Supporting-detail failures do not hide the main failure. Verified against the real logistic-platform-3 backend in the source Inspector.
reproduction: Observe a failed reload while the previous hello backend stays active.
Open the routes page; the original Inspector shows connected without explaining the failure.
Open the edited source Inspector against the same backend; assert failure cause and stale routes notice.
Follow View error logs and inspect the same startup failure; check 390px viewport for overflow.

before.note: Original routes page had no reload failure warning.

after.note: Real startup failure and stale API warning.

browser.assertion: The failed-reload banner includes real startup errors, leaves hello routes visible, and opens error-filtered logs.
steps: Open routes with the same backend.
Assert alert, retention error, stale-docs notice and existing route.
Follow error logs and verify the retention detail.

checks.reason: Strict scoped TypeScript baseline and edited code both report the same 10 existing dependency errors; comparison found no new errors.

regressions.assertion: 390px layout has no horizontal overflow and recovery text remains visible.
Next compilation and runtime errors are empty.

limitations: The installed CLI Inspector on 3210 was not replaced; live adoption requires the user-approved restart with local sources.
Standalone Scalar reference HTML is outside the Inspector shell.
Full repository acceptance and release packaging were not run.

notes: Temporary source Inspector on 3215 and its isolated browser were stopped. Existing project dev process and Docker service were preserved.
